svg.title: haris@gorcevicharis --profile
svg.desc: Terminal window with an ASCII portrait of Haris from the shoulders up. He forms the Snake, Horse and Tiger hand seals, then breathes a jet of fire, while his head slowly drops and rises every 3 seconds; the shoulders stay still.
